name: Breadboard, 400 points
description: Half-size solderless breadboard (BusBoard BB400): 0.1 in pitch, strips of five holes either side of a 0.3 in channel, power rails along both edges.

functional.claims: 400 holes; each strip of five (30 a side) and each power rail is one conductor; strips across the centre channel and adjacent strips are isolated.

timed.claims: 400 holes; each strip of five (30 a side) and each power rail is one conductor; strips across the centre channel and adjacent strips are isolated.

electrical.claims: 400 holes; each strip of five (30 a side) and each power rail is one conductor; strips across the centre channel and adjacent strips are isolated. The contacts are ideal.
omissions: contact resistance (tens of milliohms a contact)
capacitance between adjacent strips (a few pF)
the rating of 36 V and 2 A a contact is not enforced

sources.title: BusBoard Prototype Systems, BB830 / BB400 / BB170 solderless breadboard data sheets
